document_metadata.summary: Rollo, after sharing his emotional story, asks St. Luc to consider working together; St. Luc agrees to think about it before leaving.

entities.name: Rollo explains the Satyr's Tongue project to St. Luc
entities.description: Rollo describes the goal of the Satyr's Tongue project, which aims to develop a parasite capable of replacing human organ function as an alternative to organ transplants, while gesturing and using specimens to illustrate his points.

entities.name: Rollo demonstrates parasite integration on St. Luc's abdomen
entities.description: Rollo physically enacts the mechanism of parasite integration by drawing on St. Luc's stomach to illustrate how a bioengineered parasite would function inside a human host.

entities.name: St. Luc reacts with amusement and calls the idea crazy
entities.description: St. Luc laughs in response to Rollo's explanation and explicitly states that the concept of using parasites as organ replacements is crazy, engaging in a moment of shared humor despite the seriousness of the topic.

entities.name: Rollo dismisses concerns about the project's sanity
entities.description: After St. Luc labels the idea as crazy, Rollo agrees but emphatically argues that the validity of the idea does not depend on its perceived sanity, highlighting his unconventional scientific philosophy.

entities.description: A focused scientific exchange between Rollo and St. Luc regarding the Satyr's Tongue initiative, involving the presentation of its core concept, demonstration, and critical feedback, forming a coherent intellectual session.

document_metadata.title: 33、INT. TUDOR'S APARTMENT -- NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Tudor, hiding strange lumps under his skin, rebuffs Janine's concerned attempts to help, causing her to leave in tears as he smiles mysteriously.

entities.name: Janine turns off the television and returns to the sofa with her Vogue magazine
entities.description: Janine sits in front of the TV, briefly considers watching it, turns the set off, and lies back down on the sofa while reading Vogue, unaware of the disturbing trail nearby.

entities.name: Tudor discovers a large, mobile lump beneath his abdominal skin
entities.description: In his bedroom, Tudor pulls back the bedsheet and observes a lump the size of a chicken egg under the skin of his abdomen, which moves and disappears when touched.

entities.name: Tudor attempts to interact with the abdominal lump using tapping and scratching motions
entities.description: Tudor taps and scratches near his navel, mimicking the act of luring a pet, in an effort to encourage the lump under his skin to reappear and respond.

entities.name: Tudor begins drumming on his abdomen to coax the lump back to the surface
entities.description: Lying in bed, Tudor rhythmically drums on his abdomen, causing the mysterious lump beneath his skin to gradually reemerge.

entities.name: Tudor tries to grab the lump but causes it to retreat into his abdomen
entities.description: As the lump reappears, Tudor attempts to seize it with his fingers, but the pressure causes it to shrink back and nearly vanish beneath his skin, disappointing him.

entities.name: Tudor gently strokes the lump and it responds with rhythmic pulsing
entities.description: After soothing the area with soft strokes, Tudor observes the lump pulsing in a distinct, rhythmic pattern that evokes a deeply intimate and disturbing reaction from him.

entities.name: Tudor speaks deliriously to the lump, expressing desire for companionship
entities.description: In a strained, whispering voice, Tudor addresses the lump as if it were a sentient being, pleading with it not to run away and declaring that they will be friends.

entities.description: After being unconscious, Forsythe opens her eyes, becomes aware of her surroundings, and smiles at St. Luc who is watching over her anxiously on the gym mat.

entities.name: St. Luc checks Forsythe for injuries
entities.description: St. Luc examines Forsythe after she regains consciousness and determines that he cannot find anything physically wrong with her.

entities.name: Forsythe sits up with assistance from St. Luc
entities.description: With help from St. Luc, Forsythe manages to sit upright while recovering on the gym mat, indicating gradual physical recovery.

entities.name: St. Luc removes barricade from the door
entities.description: Believing that Rollo and the police should have arrived by now, St. Luc moves the barricade away from the door to prepare for their departure.

entities.name: St. Luc returns to Forsythe and kneels beside her
entities.description: After clearing the door, St. Luc comes back to Forsythe, kneels next to her on the mat, and checks if she is ready to move.

entities.name: Forsythe draws St. Luc into an intimate embrace while recounting a dream
entities.description: Forsythe pretends to seek physical support but instead pulls St. Luc close, wrapping her arms around his neck and slowly bringing her lips toward his while describing a surreal, sexually charged dream about Sigmund Freud.

entities.name: Forsythe narrates a dream about Sigmund Freud with hypnotic effect
entities.description: While physically drawing St. Luc closer, Forsythe speaks in a dreamy, hypnotic tone about a recurring fantasy involving Sigmund Freud, describing his philosophical claims about sexuality permeating all existence, which captivates St. Luc.

entities.name: St. Luc becomes entranced and nearly kisses Forsythe
entities.description: Under the spell of Forsythe's mesmerizing monologue and physical closeness, St. Luc is on the verge of kissing her despite the ambiguous and potentially dangerous situation.

entities.name: gym mat
entities.description: A specific interior sub-location where Forsythe lies and regains consciousness, indicating the immediate physical setting of the scene.

entities.name: Forsythe
entities.description: A woman who regains consciousness on a gym mat and uses a hypnotic, dreamlike narrative to influence St. Luc.
entities.summary: A nurse at Starliner Towers Medical Clinic assists Dr. St. Luc and Mr. Parkins, delivers research files, and is observed rolling down her stockings, smiling at St. Luc's gaze.

entities.name: Dr. St. Luc
entities.description: A man who checks on Forsythe after she regains consciousness, assists her, and becomes entranced by her dream narration.
entities.summary: An individual interacts with Rollo in his lab, discussing the Satyr's Tongue project and a partnership proposal, while a doctor reviews Janine's husband's medical case and plans a home visit.

entities.description: A person expected to arrive with the police, mentioned by St. Luc as part of their rescue plan.
entities.summary: A rotund, emotionally volatile scientist leads the Satyr's Tongue project, explores parasitic organ replacement, reviews Hobbes's notes on human nature, and expresses loneliness while eating knishes and drinking Coca-Cola in a lab setting.

entities.name: infected residents
entities.description: Residents who are infected and pose a threat, requiring avoidance until help arrives.

entities.name: Forsythe's throat swells as parasite tentacles emerge from her mouth
entities.description: Forsythe's mouth opens mechanically, her throat swells, and two parasite tentacles extend from her mouth, searching for a grip to pull the parasite's body through her esophagus.

entities.name: St. Luc gags Forsythe to prevent parasite emergence
entities.description: St. Luc tears a strip from his blouse, stuffs it into Forsythe's mouth, and secures it with a second strip tied around her head to prevent her from dislodging the gag.

entities.name: St. Luc restrains Forsythe and carries her toward the door
entities.description: St. Luc pins Forsythe's hands to her sides, lifts her over his shoulder despite her struggles, and moves toward the gym door.

entities.name: Mysterious woman calls out while peeking into the gym
entities.description: A middle-aged woman peeks into the gym and calls out in a crooning voice, responding to Forsythe's muffled howls with a singsong inquiry about loneliness.

entities.name: St. Luc attacks the woman and knocks her down
entities.description: As the woman continues to croon on the floor, St. Luc rushes at her, knocks her over, and continues his escape with Forsythe.

entities.name: St. Luc exits the gym with Forsythe after subduing the intruder
entities.description: After knocking down the woman, St. Luc carries the restrained Forsythe out of the gym and heads toward the nearest exit.

document_metadata.title: 82、INT. STAIRWELL -- NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: St. Luc escapes upstairs, abandoning Forsythe; below, residents surround her as a parasite is removed from her mouth and swallowed, others comforting her as he flees in disgust.

entities.name: St. Luc begins ascending the stairs while Forsythe's gag is torn by black hooks
entities.description: As St. Luc starts moving up the stairs, small black hooks emerge from Forsythe's gag, tearing through it and causing blood to soak through from within her mouth.

entities.name: Residents appear on the landing and descend with moaning and sexual gestures
entities.description: A group of residents suddenly appears above St. Luc on the next landing, notices him and Forsythe, and begins walking down the stairs while moaning, crooning, and making sexually suggestive movements toward them.

entities.name: Tentacles emerge from Forsythe's mouth and seek leverage on her face
entities.description: Blood pours from Forsythe's mouth as tentacle-like appendages push out through a slit in her gag and begin groping at her cheeks and chin for purchase.

entities.name: St. Luc attempts to force his way up the stairs through the residents
entities.description: Believing Rollo and the police are waiting at the main doors, St. Luc decides to push forward and attempts to shoulder his way past the residents blocking the staircase.

entities.name: Residents physically assault St. Luc with kissing, caressing, and clothing removal
entities.description: As St. Luc collides with the residents on the stairs, they respond by trying to kiss him, caress his body, and pull his clothes off, impeding his progress.

entities.name: Residents drag Forsythe from St. Luc's shoulders and cause him to nearly fall
entities.description: The residents succeed in pulling Forsythe off St. Luc's shoulders, nearly unbalancing him in the process and separating the two.

entities.name: St. Luc attempts to support Forsythe on her feet but fails
entities.description: After losing his grip on her, St. Luc tries to stand Forsythe upright, but her body is completely limp and unresponsive, making it impossible to keep her upright.

entities.name: St. Luc braces Forsythe against the stairway wall amid swarming residents
entities.description: St. Luc positions Forsythe against the wall of the stairwell to stabilize her as residents continue to move around them in a chaotic and threatening manner.

entities.name: St. Luc shouts Forsythe's name in a moment of desperate hopelessness
entities.description: Overcome with despair, St. Luc yells Forsythe's name repeatedly while looking at her, realizing the direness of their situation.

entities.name: Parasite partially emerges from Forsythe's mouth through torn gag
entities.description: The parasite inside Forsythe forces its way halfway out of her mouth, hanging visibly through the opening it has created in her gag.

entities.name: St. Luc releases Forsythe and she collapses to the floor
entities.description: After seeing the parasite emerge, St. Luc lets go of Forsythe, causing her to sink lifelessly to the stairs.

entities.name: Residents swarm over St. Luc and Forsythe
entities.description: With Forsythe on the ground and St. Luc defenseless, the group of residents closes in and surrounds them both, overwhelming them completely.

document_metadata.title: 83、INT. SWIMMING POOL -- NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: St. Luc is forced underwater by Betts and Janine; a parasite transfers from Janine to him during a violent kiss, causing grotesque physical transformation before he sinks, calm, amid chaotic onlookers joining the pool.

entities.name: St. Luc enters the swimming pool area from the South Tower
entities.description: Exhausted, St. Luc reaches and opens the door from the South Tower into the pool room and steps inside, momentarily clinging to the door for support.

entities.name: St. Luc observes two women swimming in the pool
entities.description: St. Luc watches Janine and Betts swimming calmly in the deep end of the dimly lit pool, finding temporary comfort in the apparent normalcy of their activity.

entities.name: St. Luc calls out to the swimmers asking for the police
entities.description: St. Luc approaches the edge of the pool and shouts to Janine and Betts, identifying himself as Dr. St. Luc and urgently inquiring if they have seen the police.

entities.name: Janine and Betts submerge playfully beneath the water
entities.description: In response to St. Luc's questions, both swimmers flick beneath the water's surface in a teasing, playful manner without answering.

entities.name: St. Luc experiences growing dread as ripples spread in the pool
entities.description: Standing at the water's edge, St. Luc feels a sinking sensation as unexplained ripples and bubbles intensify near his feet, signaling something ominous beneath the surface.

entities.name: Janine surfaces from the pool smiling
entities.description: After a period of submersion, Janine emerges from the water with a radiant smile, appearing completely at ease despite the tension around her.

entities.name: Betts surfaces and invites St. Luc into the pool
entities.description: Moments after Janine surfaces, Betts emerges from the water and gestures for St. Luc to join them, maintaining an eerie calm.

entities.name: St. Luc refuses and begins to retreat from the pool
entities.description: Shaken by the swimmers' behavior, St. Luc shakes his head and backs away from the water, turning to leave the pool area.

entities.name: Mr. Spergazzi appears and pushes St. Luc into the pool
entities.description: As St. Luc turns to leave, Mr. Spergazzi emerges from the shadows and uses his four-pronged aluminum cane to shove St. Luc backward into the pool, laughing playfully.

entities.name: Spergazzi seeks approval after pushing St. Luc into the pool
entities.description: After shoving St. Luc into the water, Spergazzi looks around the room as if expecting or enjoying recognition for his action.

entities.name: Betts grabs St. Luc and holds him underwater
entities.description: Once St. Luc is in the pool and thrashing, Betts swims up beside him, seizes him, and forcibly submerges him, preventing him from surfacing.

entities.name: swimming pool
entities.description: A physical pool located between two towers where the swimming scene takes place.

entities.name: South Tower
entities.description: One of the two towers connected to the swimming pool area, serving as an entry point to the pool.
entities.summary: The Spergazzis are at a specific residential tower connected to a swimming pool area, which also houses an elevator and serves as an entry point to the pool.

entities.name: deep end
entities.description: The deeper section of the swimming pool where the two women are swimming.

entities.name: water's edge
entities.description: The edge of the pool where St. Luc stands while calling out to the swimmers.

entities.name: shadows
entities.description: A dimly lit area behind St. Luc where Mr. Spergazzi appears before pushing him into the pool.

entities.name: Dr. St. Luc
entities.description: A doctor who enters the swimming pool area and interacts with swimmers and Mr. Spergazzi, showing signs of exhaustion and distress.
entities.summary: An individual interacts with Rollo in his lab, discussing the Satyr's Tongue project and a partnership proposal, while a doctor reviews Janine's husband's medical case and plans a home visit.

entities.name: Janine
entities.description: A woman swimming in the pool who surfaces smiling after submerging playfully with Betts.
entities.summary: A neurotic, dependent woman in her early thirties prepares breakfast, avoids eating, seeks medical advice for her husband Nicholas Tudor's condition, and visits someone familiar, showing concern and emotional instability.

entities.name: Betts
entities.description: A woman swimming in the pool who surfaces calmly and gestures for St. Luc to join, then later grabs and holds him underwater.
entities.summary: A confident woman in her forties, involved in advertising, mentors Janine while unknowingly hosting a parasitic entity in her apartment that affects her behavior and physical state.

entities.name: Mr. Spergazzi
entities.description: A man who appears from the shadows and uses his cane to push St. Luc into the pool, seeking approval afterward.
entities.summary: An elderly Italian man in apartment 307 uses a cane, communicates with a doorman and St. Luc via intercom, comforts his wife during medical care, and calls for a nurse when distressed, often reverting to Italian.

entities.name: four-pronged aluminum cane
entities.description: A cane used by Mr. Spergazzi to push St. Luc into the pool, described as having four prongs and made of aluminum.

entities.name: Betts and other residents pressure Janine to kiss St. Luc
entities.description: Betts and various residents chant and laugh, urging Janine to kiss St. Luc, creating a coercive and performative atmosphere at the poolside.

entities.name: Janine kisses St. Luc under coercion while Betts restrains him
entities.description: Janine swims to St. Luc and forcibly kisses him, holding his head while Betts pins his arms behind his back, initiating a violent parasitic transfer.

entities.name: Parasite transfers from Janine to St. Luc during the kiss
entities.description: As Janine and St. Luc are locked in a kiss, a parasite moves from her body into his through their connected mouths, marked by visible physical distortions and tentacles.

entities.name: St. Luc resists and attempts to break free from Janine and Betts
entities.description: After realizing the parasitic invasion, St. Luc jolts in terror and struggles to pull away, briefly separating from Janine while still partially restrained.

entities.name: St. Luc and Janine sink underwater still locked together
entities.description: Following the kiss and parasitic transfer, St. Luc and Janine twist and sink beneath the water's surface while physically entangled, continuing the struggle.

entities.name: Dozens of residents flood into the pool room and gather at the poolside
entities.description: A large group of residents, including previously seen characters, enters the pool area and joins the scene, surrounding the pool as spectators.

entities.name: Residents react ecstatically to the underwater struggle as if at a ritual
entities.description: The gathered residents clap, laugh, moan, and croon, treating the violent parasitic transfer and submersion as a spectacle resembling a communal rite.

entities.name: Some residents jump into the pool and pull others in
entities.description: Inspired by the scene, several residents throw themselves into the water and forcibly bring others in, escalating the chaotic and ritualistic atmosphere.

entities.name: St. Luc continues struggling underwater amid surrounding residents
entities.description: Deep beneath the surface, St. Luc fights to free himself from Janine as other residents splash down around them, intensifying the submerged chaos.

entities.name: Parasite fully enters St. Luc and begins transforming him
entities.description: The parasite completes its transfer into St. Luc’s body, causing his throat to swell, blood to leak from his nose and mouth, and his breath to boil the water as enzymes flood his system.

entities.name: Janine releases St. Luc as both drift apart, now calm
entities.description: After the parasite transfer concludes, Janine lets go of St. Luc, and both float apart in a state of eerie tranquility, transformed by the infection.

entities.name: Residents celebrate in the pool with splashing, swimming, and embracing
entities.description: Following the transformation, the residents continue their frenzied activity in the water, engaging in chaotic yet joyful physical interactions.
